criteriaResolved.title: Atmospheric Composition & Surface Meteorology
criteriaResolved.summary: Mars CO2 (95.32%), N2 (2.7%), Ar (1.6%), O2 (0.13%) at 6.1-8.8 mbar (MSL SAM/REMS); Moon surface exosphere 3e-15 bar requiring 57.2 kPa (8.3 psi, 34% O2) habitat pressure.

criteriaResolved.title: Ionizing Radiation & Topographic Sky-View Shielding Dosimetry
criteriaResolved.summary: 128x128 radiation dose rasters (mSv/yr) computed from LRO LOLA SKYV_65S_240M solid-angle sky visibility (steradians) + 30m topographic horizon shielding calibrated to LRO CRaTER (380 mSv/yr) and MSL RAD (233 mSv/yr).

criteriaResolved.title: Bulk Subsurface Water/Ice Concentration (WEH wt%)
criteriaResolved.summary: 128x128 Water-Equivalent Hydrogen (WEH wt%) rasters derived from LRO LEND epithermal neutron suppression + Diviner/LPSR cold traps (0.4-5.6 wt% WEH in Shackleton PSR) and MSL Curiosity DAN active/passive neutron spectroscopy (1.5-5.2 wt% WEH in Gale/Jezero hydrated strata).

criteriaResolved.title: Multi-Year Solar Illumination Continuity (%)
criteriaResolved.summary: 128x128 solar illumination rasters (% of multi-year ephemeris sunlit) extracted directly from Mazarico et al. (2011/2016) LRO LOLA 60m South Pole Illumination Atlas and 30m horizon ray-casting.

criteriaResolved.title: Direct-to-Earth (DTE) & Orbital Relay Link Visibility (%)
criteriaResolved.summary: 128x128 Direct-to-Earth (DTE) libration visibility (%) extracted from LRO LOLA AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608_EARTH.IMG for the Lunar South Pole, nearside DTE line-of-sight, and Mars UHF relay visibility.

criteriaResolved.title: Geotechnical Bearing Capacity (kPa) & Sub-Meter Rock Abundance (%)
criteriaResolved.summary: 128x128 sub-meter rock abundance (% areal fraction) and regolith bearing capacity (kPa) derived from LRO Diviner Rock Abundance (Bandfield et al. 2011) and MGS TES Thermal Inertia (Putzig & Mellon 2007).
